title: Board-Approved Schedule of Repeat Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
The Board of Trustees sets a higher tuition late fee on a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions that has been late before in the same school year. The schedule turns on the number of late fees the enrollment already carries in the school year when the new fee is assessed.

| Late fees the enrollment already carries in the school year | Late fee charged |
|---|---|
| none | the type's tuition late fee (25.00 on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) in the board-approved fee schedule) |
| exactly one | 30.00, in place of the type's tuition late fee |
| two or more | 35.00, in place of the type's tuition late fee |

Only late fees already posted on the same enrollment are counted; late fees on another child's enrollment, or on an enrollment of an earlier school year, are not.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical enrollment)

- The enrollment's ledger shows late fees for September and November and none since. The fee now assessed is its third: the enrollment already carries two, so the fee is 35.00.
- The ledger shows one late fee, for October. The fee now assessed is 30.00.
- The ledger shows no late fee this school year. The fee is the type's tuition late fee.
